answer: Weight in the umber grows with the square of tenure: a sparrow that has burned 1 signal and passed a random judged audit in each of t consecutive epochs votes with t², and one missed epoch resets t to zero. The umber cross-checks audit answers and voids any sparrows giving near-duplicates. Each vote a farm of fresh clones casts costs a full signal, while a 100-epoch veteran's costs a hundredth, so the farm must outspend veterans a hundredfold or wait epochs it cannot run faster. It breaks if aged sparrows can be bought.
